original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚高原州发生多车相撞事故，FRSC确认20人死亡
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚联邦道路安全队（FRSC）确认，高原州Hawan Kibo至乔斯路段发生多车相撞事故，造成20人死亡。事故涉及4辆车、共25人，另有5人受伤。初步判断刹车失灵和失控可能是事故原因。

location.raw_text: along the Hawan Kibo-Jos route in Plateau

key_facts.fact: 尼日利亚联邦道路安全队确认高原州多车相撞事故造成20人死亡
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: THE Federal Road Safety Corps (FRSC) has confirmed the death of 20 people in a multiple road traffic crash along the Hawan Kibo-Jos route in Plateau.

key_facts.fact: 事故涉及25人，其中23名男性、2名女性
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: He said 25 people were involved in the crash, comprising 23 males and two females.
five people, comprising three males and two females, sustained injuries, while 20 males died in the crash.

key_facts.fact: 事故涉及4辆车，包括一辆豪沃卡车
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Four vehicles were involved in the crash, including a Howo Sino truck with registration number AGL 525 YN.

key_facts.fact: 刹车失灵和失控被认定为可能原因
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: with brake failure and loss of control identified as likely causes.

uncertainties: 事故原因（刹车失灵和失控）仅为可能原因，尚未最终确认
目前仅有一个来源（FRSC声明），缺乏独立交叉验证
